learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn where water comes from, why it is so important for life, and how we can save every single drop!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every living thing gets thirsty! Humans need water to drink, wash, and cook. Plants need water to grow, and fishes need water to swim and live.
When it rains, water fills up our ponds, lakes, and big rivers. The clean rain water slowly travels through pipes to reach the taps in our homes!
Water is like magic and we must not waste it. Always close the tap while brushing your teeth, and collect rainwater to water your garden plants.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Water Hero Badge!
fun_activity.instructions: Cut a piece of paper into the shape of a big blue water drop. Write I AM A WATER HERO on it, color it, and pin it to your shirt!

quick_recap: ⭐ All humans, animals, and plants need water to stay alive.
⭐ Rain is the biggest source of water for our rivers and ponds.
⭐ We must be very careful to never waste even a single drop of water.
